summary: The BGP MULTI_EXIT_DISC (MED) attribute lets a network tell a neighbor which entry point into its network is best. It works in many cases but can cause problems in dynamic or complex topologies. This document discusses implementation and deployment considerations for implementers and operators. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A city tells visitors which gate to use. Usually that helps, but sometimes it causes confusing traffic jams. This note explains what to watch for.
